text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'm so glad you're enjoying our claw machine! ♪

text_block_list.text: Not only that, but you did great! Once you get the hang of it, you'll be a claw machine master in no time at all!

text_block_list.text: We'll have to have a contest to see who can win the most prizes someday… Hehe. I'm looking forward to it.
